text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After our outing—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm heading out ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What, is there still something else?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that anything's wrong, but...
Even though we just went out together, her unusually cold reaction bothers me."
choice_data_list: You didn't have fun today... did you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Why?
It doesn't really matter, does it?
choice_data_list: Since you're here, I want you to enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hah, annoying.
That's my own business, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Whether I have fun or not,
it's none of your business."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Is that all you wanted to say?
Because I'd like to head back now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...And on the day the new weapons drop, too.
I want to check them out already...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that fun cannot be forced. Even so,
I want them to look back at the end of the day and be glad they came, and I intend to do everything I can to make that happen.
choice_data_list: Then I'll just have fun entertaining you on my own.
Then I'll just entertain you however I want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What's that, I don't get it at aaall.
choice_data_list: I want to see you smile.
I just want to see you smile.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Are you an idiot or what?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Despite spewing insults like that, she doesn't leave.
She seems to be waiting to see what I'll do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for how to entertain her, gaming is her hobby. That means she might be up for playing something with game-like elements. How about—
choice_data_list: Let's settle this with a game of tag!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Kids? Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I was an idiot for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My spur-of-the-moment idea just left them dumbfounded...
Still, this is a hard-won chance. I can't back down now...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
…………Look.
Aren't you embarrassed?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while being completely ignored after that,
I somehow managed to keep talking to her—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Hold on, that's enough already...

text_block_list.name: Baker
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
How about some freshly baked bread?
It's fluffy and delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, the bread...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...! N-No, that wasn't what it looked like!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't playing along with the word chain!
I just thought I'd buy some bread, that's all...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what?
You didn't notice at all...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, damn it, I shouldn't have said that...!
choice_data_list: Looks like you lose, Taishin, huh

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "I-I told you that's not it! Ugh... wipe that smirk off your face!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey... first of all, do you honestly think
a match between you and me would even be a contest?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then why challenge me to a fight you're gonna lose?
Surely you've got better options.
choice_data_list: I wanted to compete at something Taishin likes

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...
Treating me like a kid who'll run off at the drop of a hat...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever.
You're the one who brought it up, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...!
I have to go after them...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, Umamusume are fast even when they aren't running seriously. Naturally, no matter how desperately I moved my legs, there was no way I could catch up—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Has she not arrived yet?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, there's no way a regular human could ever beat an Umamusume in a contest.
You're pretty dumb for a Trainer, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, in the first place...
Saying you want to see me smile...
I just don't get it at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Maybe it would've been fine to stop for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...No, are you an idiot?
Jeez... idiot.
